## What's in it

- **`fosay-mandate-policy`**: policy on the agent's `:pay` rule. Per-payment cap, rolling budget in a fixed 9-slot ring, recipient allowlist, pause, mandate hash. `enforce` emits no events, so payments pass x402 facilitator checks.
- **`fosay-approvals`**: over-limit request queue (`propose`, `execute`, `cancel`, `expire`). Owner approvals are bound to `execute(id)`.
- 48 tests, including end-to-end flows on the canonical OZ account with real Ed25519 signatures. Invariants I1–I7 are mapped to tests in [`SECURITY.md`](https://github.com/fosay-labs/fosay-contract/blob/v0.1.0-testnet/SECURITY.md#threat-model).

Exercised end to end on testnet by [`fosay-app` v0.1.0-testnet](https://github.com/fosay-labs/fosay-app/releases/tag/v0.1.0-testnet), including an x402 payment verified and settled by the official `@x402/stellar` facilitator.
